tasks.short: Count and record the number of tickets collected.

steps.what: Capture actual collected tickets by scanning or manually entering each ticket or paper batch into a local count draft
inputs: actual collected tickets
event and gate identifiers
outputs: actual collected-ticket capture draft with exceptions

steps.what: Count actual collected tickets, remove exact duplicate capture IDs and calculate totals by event and gate
inputs: actual collected-ticket capture draft with exceptions
outputs: draft collected-ticket totals and duplicate flags

steps.what: Reconcile actual paper tickets, unreadable codes, re-entry cases and capture gaps against the draft count
inputs: draft collected-ticket totals and duplicate flags
actual collected-ticket capture draft with exceptions
actual paper or unreadable tickets

steps.what: Approve the finished collected-ticket count, event, gate and internal record destination
inputs: reconciled actual collected-ticket count record

steps.what: Commit the approved collected-ticket count to the internal event record
inputs: approved actual ticket count version

tasks.design: Configure an actual-collection count view in {OTHER}, the existing ticketing or gate-count system. Human scanning, paper handling and manual exceptions remain counted in s1 and s3. The native view totals actual captured collections, not tickets sold or reservations. Capture and totals remain a draft until reconciliation and approval; the final internal count commit is its own gated step. Changes void approval. No new admission decisions, automatic refunds or outward messages are included. No model is needed.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated manual tallying and copying of actual ticket collections.
tasks.enabler_now: Native ticketing count views and draft batch entry.
tasks.still_hard: Paper tickets, re-entry and missing collection evidence.
tasks.human_edge: Explain discrepancies between actual tickets and the recorded count.

ambition.what: Reduce repeat tallying of actual collected tickets.

tasks.altitude: Physical capture remains with the ticket taker.

reach.learn: Distinguish sold, admitted and actually collected ticket totals.

evidence.claim: Ticketing systems can provide native event count views; the actual collection capture and reconciliation effort still needs local measurement.

assumptions: Shares are provisional. s1 explicitly retains human scanning and manual entry of actual ticket ID or batch quantity, event, gate and collection status. No ready scan stream or free conversion of paper tickets is assumed.

A scan is a draft count input here, not an unrepresented authoritative admission write. If the deployed system commits admission records during scanning, that separate per-event action and approval must be included before deployment.
s3 retains physical recount and duplicate/re-entry decisions. Exact duplicate capture IDs can be flagged; legitimate repeat entry is not automatically deleted.
Any capture already owned by a separate admission task must be allocated once when rolling up the role.
unknowns: Actual paper-ticket share and native draft-count support.
research_questions: Does total capture plus reconciliation beat manual counting for actual event volumes?

already_counted.description: Actual capture, reconciliation and final record review.

incremental.description: Maintain event/gate count mappings and exception rules.

approvals.approved_version: exact reconciled actual tickets-collected count, event, gate and internal record destination

time_saved_range_pct.basis: High: forty actual-ticket tally hours saved less two upkeep. Low: paper exceptions and capture remove tally benefit. Same-event-record commitment retains full effort; sold tickets never replace actual collected tickets.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Lead tours and answer visitors' exhibit questions.

steps.what: Look up current exhibit facts, route restrictions and answers in approved visitor information
inputs: current exhibit guide
actual route or exhibit changes
outputs: checked tour references and unresolved questions

steps.what: Lead the actual tour, explain exhibits and answer visitors' questions in the moment
inputs: checked tour references and unresolved questions
actual visitors, questions and route conditions
outputs: actual tour delivery and unresolved visitor questions

steps.what: Prepare the actual tour note with route issues and questions that could not be answered
inputs: actual tour delivery and unresolved visitor questions

steps.what: Approve the finished actual tour issue note and internal record destination
inputs: complete actual tour issue note

steps.what: Commit the approved actual tour issue note to internal visitor-service records
inputs: approved tour note version

tasks.design: Configure native search and exhibit/route links in {DOCS} and {OTHER}, the existing visitor-information system. The attendant checks current facts and leads the tour personally. Actual unresolved questions and route issues are manually captured after the tour, then the finished note is approved before a separate internal commit. Changes void approval. No model, automatic visitor answer or external follow-up send is included.
tasks.previous_blocker: Current exhibit information can be scattered across guides and change notes.
tasks.enabler_now: Native indexed guides and route links.
tasks.still_hard: Visitor interest, accessibility and spontaneous questions.
tasks.human_edge: Adapt the explanation and pace to the actual group.

ambition.what: Reduce reference retrieval around existing tours.

reach.learn: Retain unanswered questions instead of guessing an answer.

evidence.claim: Native guide search can retrieve approved exhibit facts and route references.

assumptions: Shares are provisional for tours where an issue note is part of existing work. If no note is required, remove its baseline and benefit rather than inventing one.
s1 includes manually checking current exhibit ID, route changes and guide version. Existing exhibit facts come from the current guide; no new curator research is demanded for free.
s3 manually captures actual tour/date, route problem and unresolved question. Personal visitor details are unnecessary for this note.
unknowns: Actual guide indexing and tour-note practice.
research_questions: How much current-reference retrieval occurs during a typical tour?

already_counted.description: Actual tour issue capture and final note review.

incremental.description: Maintain exhibit and route reference links.

approvals.approved_version: exact actual tour issue note and internal visitor-service record location

time_saved_range_pct.basis: High: four tour-reference hours saved less half an hour upkeep. Low: native references already work. Same-visitor-service-record commitment, tour delivery and actual issue capture retain full effort.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Manage inventory or sale of artist merchandise.

steps.what: Physically check artist merchandise stock, sizes, prices and actual received or missing items
inputs: actual merchandise stock
existing item and artist price records
outputs: actual checked stock and item exceptions

steps.what: Assist the customer with artist merchandise choices, sizes and availability
inputs: actual checked stock and item exceptions
customer's actual request

steps.what: Prepare the exact sale cart by capturing actual item variants, quantities and configured prices
inputs: customer's chosen merchandise
actual checked stock and item exceptions
outputs: complete proposed sale cart and payment amount

steps.what: Confirm the final actual sale cart, items, price and payment destination with the customer
inputs: complete proposed sale cart and payment amount
outputs: approved sale cart and payment version

steps.what: Take payment for the approved sale using the till and actual customer payment authorization
inputs: approved sale cart and payment version
actual customer payment authorization or cash
outputs: actual paid or failed transaction result

steps.what: Physically hand over the paid actual merchandise and resolve immediate item or payment exceptions
inputs: actual paid or failed transaction result
customer's chosen merchandise
outputs: actual merchandise handover or unresolved exception

steps.what: Prepare the actual sale receipt and stock update from payment result, handover and physical stock exceptions
inputs: actual paid or failed transaction result
actual merchandise handover or unresolved exception
actual checked stock and item exceptions
outputs: complete actual receipt and inventory update package

steps.what: Approve the final actual receipt, customer delivery method and stock changes with exact record destination
inputs: complete actual receipt and inventory update package

steps.what: Issue the approved actual receipt to the customer by the confirmed till delivery method
inputs: approved actual sale record package

steps.what: Commit the approved actual stock changes and sale reference to the internal inventory record
inputs: approved actual sale record package

tasks.design: Configure item variants, prices, draft carts and staged actual stock updates in {OTHER}, the existing merchandise POS, payment terminal and inventory system. All physical counts, customer assistance and handover remain human. A complete cart is confirmed before taking payment; actual payment and handover then produce the receipt and inventory package. That final actual package receives its own approval before separate receipt issuance and internal stock commit. Changes void approval. No model, inferred payment success or assumed stock receipt is used.
tasks.previous_blocker: Prices, sale details and actual inventory changes are copied between till and stock records.
tasks.enabler_now: Native POS item lookup, payment controls and staged inventory fields.
tasks.still_hard: Actual stock discrepancies, customer needs and failed payments.
tasks.human_edge: Ensure the customer receives the actual correct merchandise.

ambition.what: Reduce till and record handling around merchandise sales.

tasks.altitude: Customer service and stock custody remain human.

reach.learn: Distinguish cart quantities from paid and physically handed-over goods.

evidence.claim: Native POS systems can use item variants and prices, initiate payments and prepare receipts and stock updates.

assumptions: Shares are provisional across inventory and sale work. s1 includes actual physical counting and manual item/size/quantity identification; s3 includes scanning or manual cart entry.
s5 retains actual cash handling or terminal/customer interaction and failed payment handling. Savings are repeated operator entry, never customer wait time or payment processing runtime.
s7 includes manual entry of actual transaction ID, payment status, handover quantity, stock correction and receipt method. No sales ledger or inventory write is hidden in draft cart preparation.

The proposed staged inventory/receipt mode must be supported natively; if the till automatically commits stock on charge, that commit requires its own represented gate and the saving must be recalculated.
unknowns: Native staged stock support and cash/card mix.
research_questions: Does actual sale handling improve after physical stock and payment exceptions?

already_counted.description: Actual record preparation and final receipt/stock review.

incremental.description: Maintain actual item variants, prices and stock mappings.

approvals.approved_version: exact final sale cart, amount and payment target, with actual customer authorization still required
exact receipt derived from actual payment result and confirmed customer receipt delivery method
actual stock changes, transaction reference and exact internal inventory destination

time_saved_range_pct.basis: High: six cart-entry, three payment-control and five actual receipt-issue hours saved less one upkeep. Low: native till functions remove new benefit. Same-inventory-record commitment, physical stock work and customer assistance retain full effort.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

event requirements and existing staff skill records

steps.what: Prepare a proposed usher schedule using native availability and coverage checks and human assignment choices
inputs: checked roster inputs and unresolved coverage
outputs: complete proposed usher roster and internal staff notice

steps.what: Commit the approved usher assignments to the internal roster
inputs: approved usher roster package

steps.what: Send the approved roster notice to the named internal staff and volunteer corps members

versioned scheduled usher roster

actual staff attendance and event conditions

tasks.design: Configure native availability, skills and coverage checks in {OTHER}, the staff/volunteer scheduling system. Actual availability capture and staff choices stay human. Finish and approve the pre-event roster and {EMAIL} notice before separate assignment commit and internal send. Actual shift management then remains human; only after the shift are actual attendance and changes captured, approved and separately committed. Each changed artifact requires renewed approval. No model or automated staff ranking is needed.
tasks.previous_blocker: Roster preparation repeats coverage checks and copying while actual shift changes need separate records.
tasks.enabler_now: Native scheduling constraints and controlled roster/shift records.
tasks.still_hard: Volunteer needs, last-minute absences and actual service supervision.
tasks.human_edge: Allocate people fairly and respond to actual event conditions.

ambition.what: Reduce schedule and record handling around human staff management.

tasks.altitude: People management remains with the coordinator.

reach.learn: Separate scheduled assignments from actual attendance and post changes.

evidence.claim: Native staff scheduling tools can check availability and coverage and route approved rosters.

assumptions: Shares are provisional. s1 includes reading existing replies, asking clarifying questions and manually entering actual availability, staff ID, relevant skill, event, post and time. No new free self-service capture is assumed.
The volunteer corps is treated as internal operating personnel for roster notices. External agency commitments require a separate external step and approval.
s6 retains actual briefing, supervision and urgent verbal changes. s7 manually captures actual attendance, post changes, times and issues; scheduled attendance is never written as actual attendance.
Any additional authoritative mid-shift roster write must use the same final-version approval and commit cycle and be counted within actual shift work.
unknowns: Native coverage rules and actual shift-record practice.
research_questions: How much roster work remains after availability clarification and actual shift capture?

already_counted.description: Actual availability capture, final roster review and actual shift capture/review.

incremental.description: Maintain staffing rules and roster/shift templates.

approvals.approved_version: final proposed usher assignments, event, posts and times in the internal roster
exact final roster notice and named internal staff/volunteer recipients
actual completed shift attendance and changes with internal record location

time_saved_range_pct.basis: High: six roster-preparation and two actual staff-notice send hours saved less one upkeep. Low: native roster and notice functions remove new benefit. Same-roster/shift-record saves, actual availability capture and human management retain full effort.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional
